description: This file defines a React component for managing plugins in the Mattermost admin console, including plugin upload, enable/disable, remove, and settings management.

classes.name: PluginManagement
classes.description: React component class for plugin management in the admin console, extending OLDAdminSettings, handling plugin upload, enable/disable, remove, and configuration.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Extracts plugin-related configuration from component state to the config object.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state based on provided configuration.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches plugin statuses if plugin management is enabled.

methods.name: handleChooseFileClick
methods.description: Triggers file input click for plugin upload.

methods.name: handleUpload
methods.description: Handles file selection for plugin upload.

methods.name: helpSubmitUpload
methods.description: Uploads plugin file, handles errors, and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSubmitUpload
methods.description: Handles form submission for plugin upload.

methods.name: handleOverwriteUploadPluginCancel
methods.description: Cancels overwrite modal for plugin upload.

methods.name: handleOverwriteUploadPlugin
methods.description: Confirms overwrite and re-uploads plugin.

methods.name: onPluginDownloadUrlChange
methods.description: Updates state with plugin download URL.

methods.name: installFromUrl
methods.description: Installs plugin from URL, handles errors, and updates state.

methods.name: getMarketplaceURLHelpText
methods.description: Provides help text for marketplace URL input based on current state.

methods.name: canSave
methods.description: Checks if plugin URL is set for saving.

methods.name: handleSubmitInstall
methods.description: Handles form submission for plugin installation from URL.

methods.name: handleOverwriteInstallPluginCancel
methods.description: Cancels overwrite modal for plugin installation.

methods.name: handleOverwriteInstallPlugin
methods.description: Confirms overwrite and re-installs plugin from URL.

methods.name: showRemovePluginModal
methods.description: Displays modal to confirm plugin removal.

methods.name: handleRemovePluginCancel
methods.description: Cancels plugin removal modal.

methods.name: handleRemovePlugin
methods.description: Confirms plugin removal.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Removes plugin via action and handles errors.

methods.name: handleEnable
methods.description: Enables a plugin via action.

methods.name: handleDisable
methods.description: Disables a plugin via action.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title of the plugin management page.

methods.name: renderOverwritePluginModal
methods.description: Renders modal to confirm plugin overwrite.

methods.name: renderRemovePluginModal
methods.description: Renders modal to confirm plugin removal.

methods.name: renderEnablePluginsSetting
methods.description: Renders toggle for enabling plugins.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the main plugin management UI including upload, list, and settings.
